message: Laya reviewed 188 / 188 real frames. 0 model-supported motion candidates; 0 deterministic peak associations are not confirmed detections.
note: Every successfully loaded exposure was reviewed, with earliest/latest context in long groups. Candidate tracks require four independent nights, >=30 days, >=5-sigma fitted velocity, low scatter and leave-one-out consistency. Batch-level VQA support requires at least two points from that track in the reviewed panel; it is not individual-source identification. Original arrays and masks are unchanged. Faint motion can be rejected; zero candidates does not prove no motion.
scope: Every available cached WISE exposure; loaded subset only, not the full release.
